item.title: Iran War Live Updates: U.S. Begins Blockade of Strait of Hormuz
item.summary: President Trump asserted that Iran asked for another round of negotiations, but Iran did not immediately respond. The U.S. military is blocking ships entering or leaving Iran in an effort to cut off its oil income.

item.title: Israelis Don’t Feel Much Like Victors in War With Iran
item.summary: The regime in Iran has not changed and the nuclear and missile threats have not been eliminated, leaving many Israelis to wonder what this was all for.

item.title: As Internet Blackout Hits Day 45, Iranians Bemoan State Hypocrisy and Economic Risks
item.summary: Iranians enduring the latest communications shutdown warn that it’s crippling businesses. Critics say officials flagrantly use the internet they block citizens from.

item.title: To Fill Drone Force Ranks, Russia Targets a New Demographic: Students
item.summary: Recruitment sessions have taken place at hundreds of universities and colleges across the country.

item.title: For Months, Pope Avoided Clash With Trump. Now He’s Clapping Back.
item.summary: President Trump lashed out on Sunday night at Pope Leo XIV, who responded hours later by saying he would continue to oppose war.

item.title: Killer’s Parents Could Have Prevented Southport Attack in U.K., Report Says
item.summary: An official inquiry said the perpetrator’s parents, as well as government agencies, had missed several chances to avert the deadly attack.

item.title: To Open the Strait of Hormuz, Trump Wants to Blockade Iran. Experts Are Skeptical.
item.summary: President Trump’s announcement of a U.S. blockade was his latest effort to pressure Iran to negotiate after direct talks over the weekend did not yield an agreement.

item.title: Iran Blockade Sets Up a Test of Which Side Can Endure More Pain
item.summary: President Trump is trying to choke off the country’s lifeline with a blockade of the Strait of Hormuz. But the Iranians are betting that his tolerance for political pain is limited.

item.title: ‘The Strangest Sleepover Ever’: Dutch Skeptical as Their Royals Visit Trump
item.summary: The Dutch king and queen are set to stay at the White House on Monday night. At a time of trans-Atlantic tension, the Netherlands isn’t sure how it feels about that.

item.title: Two Iran-linked Ships Passed Through Strait of Hormuz Ahead of U.S. Blockade
item.summary: The vessels exited the Strait of Hormuz on Monday, hours before a U.S. naval blockade took effect.
